page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.13xlarge is a high-capacity virtual instance categorized within the memory-optimized family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors built on the x86_64 architecture, providing 52 vCPUs alongside 192 GB of total system memory. This configuration establishes a resource allocation of approximately 3.69 GB of memory per core. The server does not contain dedicated graphics hardware or hardware accelerators, focusing its resources strictly on general CPU execution and memory-backed operations.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 12 Gbps, supporting stable communication for distributed infrastructure and backend services. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not provide bundled local NVMe or SSD storage. Consequently, all persistent data storage and operating system volumes must be attached via remote block storage services, which offloads local disk maintenance while making total storage throughput dependent on network-attached volume specifications.

From an efficiency perspective, the provision of 52 dedicated physical-grade execution threads combined with 192 GB of memory delivers substantial parallel processing capacity without the resource overhead of attached local disks or GPUs. This architecture is well suited for enterprise workloads that require balanced CPU and memory resources, including medium-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems, batch processing, and multi-threaded enterprise backend services.
